We have delivered rapid robotization at scale. Now we are developing and deploying Physical AI products that use intelligence, flexibility and adaptability to go a step beyond traditional automation. Agile ONE: the humanoid for industry Agile ONE brings physical AI to industry. With unprecedentedly dexterous hands, advanced perception, and intuitive human interaction, the humanoid robot handles industrial tasks autonomously, precisely, and efficiently. Find out more Diana 7: The art of dexterity Developed to intuitively perform any automation task, this force-controlled robotic arm is equipped with torque sensors in all seven axes and is supported by our AI-driven software. Find out more Thor series: Precision meets payload The Thor series is engineered to meet diverse industrial needs, providing payload options of 3, 7, 12, and 20 kilograms along with unique features tailored to different applications. This versatility allows Thor to excel in both ultra-precise operations and heavy-duty applications. Find out more Human-like touch: Agile Hand The anthropomorphic Agile Hand is composed of five identical, modularly designed robotic fingers. Thanks to its humanoid dexterity, it can perform delicate tasks and offers a hand where we humans can’t. Find out more Shared Expertise: Mobile robotics We develop our cutting-edge Autonomous Mobile Robot (AMR) solution in partnership with our experts at BÄR Automation and idealworks. Components can be flexibly combined with each other so that individual steps can be synchronized optimally, to enhance efficiency and flexibility, streamline operations and boost productivity in a wide range of environments. Find out more Everything connected: AgileCore Our powerful software platform enables system integrators and operators to develop and deploy next-generation automation solutions. It’s like a one-stop shop for all your robotic software needs. Cutting-edge AI technology powers our robotic systems: AgileAI is the brain of our automation solutions, enabling them to process data, make real-time decisions and flexibly adapt to changing conditions. It can be programmed using natural language. This advanced platform enhances our robots’ performance, driving innovation and efficiency across various applications. Find out more We are proud of our long track record of consistently developing the right solutions to meet specific application needs across a broad range of industries and services. Driving innovation We are pushing the boundaries of physical AI products: intelligent, flexible and adaptable robots that get tasks done. Agile ONE – Physical AI for the production floor | Agile Robots SE Skip main navigation About us Products Agile ONE Diana 7 Thor series Agile Hand Mobile robotics AgileCore Physical AI Career News & more Contact us EN EN - English DE - German You are now on the European site Visit the Chinese site © Agile Robots SE 2026 Imprint Privacy policy GTC Privacy Settings EN EN - English DE - German You are now on the European site Visit the Chinese site Physical AI for the production floor: Agile ONE Agile ONE brings Physical AI to industry. With unprecedentedly dexterous hands, advanced perception, and intuitive human interaction, the humanoid robot handles industrial tasks autonomously, precisely, and efficiently. Designed for industry Agile ONE is your reliable co-worker on the production floor. It moves autonomously between workstations, collaborates seamlessly with humans, and gets the job done – in manufacturing, logistics, and beyond. Powered by real-world industrial data, Agile ONE learns, adapts, and evolves with every task, optimizing performance and efficiency across your operations. Discover the features Sensitive perception Agile ONE sees, hears, understands, and responds. Equipped with intelligent cameras, LiDARs and advanced speech recognition, the humanoid dynamically interacts and communicates with its environment. Real-time feedback Agile ONE constantly communicates. A chest information display, expressive eyes, and a proximity sensor signal spatial awareness and provide real-time feedback - creating intuitive and safe interactions. Powerful arms Designed to closely mirror the human anatomy, Agile ONE’s dexterous robotic arms deliver precision and strength in every movement. Human-like dexterity With modular fingers, 21 joints, and integrated force and tactile sensors, Agile ONE‘s hands closely imitate the human hand, enabling precise manipulation, reliable grasping, and natural interaction with a variety of objects. Natural movements With a walking speed of 2 meters per second, Agile ONE moves with human-like speed. A life-sized presence in the workplace Engineered for stability and movement Walks at your pace, works to your rhythm powerful payload The production line is our training ground Constantly evolving, Agile ONE draws on real industrial data from the production floor, extensive simulated datasets, and robot teleoperation and human data gathered at our data farms. This extensive and diverse data is used to train our Robot Foundation Models. These models enable the humanoid to autonomously execute complex tasks with greater accuracy, adaptability, and safety across diverse industrial environments. Advanced perception, tangible results Sensitive touch With integrated force and tactile sensors, Agile ONE’s hands redefine robotic dexterity - mastering delicate and powerful tasks with unmatched precision and adaptability. Intelligent vision Agile ONE’s superhuman vision enables advanced spatial awareness, tracks movements and detects obstacles – even while carrying oversized objects humans can’t see past. Intuitive interactions Agile ONE‘s responsive eyes, light signals, chest display, and vocal responses enable intuitive communication, delivering real-time updates on its current status. Autonomous decision-making The Robotic Foundation Model behind Agile ONE is trained on real-world industrial data – giving it the edge in handling real-world industrial tasks. Standing ready. Not stand-alone Agile ONE is more than a stand-alone system - it’s a part of a wider, integrated production ecosystem. It’s designed to work seamlessly alongside our other robotic solutions, each part of the system intelligent, interlinked, and continuously learning. The result? Manufacturing systems that adapt in real time and continuously learn from every process – and factories that are smarter, more adaptable and more efficient. Driving innovation We are pushing the boundaries of physical AI products: intelligent, flexible and adaptable robots that get tasks done.
